title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Starlight Theatre, Kansas City, Missouri | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Starlight Theatre in Kansas City, Missouri, USA, on 3 September 2018.

What a great way to spend Labor Day Kansas City peace and love ??????????

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) September 4, 2018

It was the 26th show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

Starr had previously performed at the Starlight Theatre on 4 October 2014.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Graham Gouldman: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
